(()=>{const states=[...document.querySelectorAll('.state')].map(e=>e.textContent);if(states.includes('Not assessed')||states.includes('not-assessed'))throw Error('Lost assessments');if(states.filter(s=>s==='verified').length!==5)throw Error('Wrong verified count');if(document.querySelectorAll('.check[aria-label=Checked]').length!==2)throw Error('Invented or missing ticks');const search=document.querySelector('#search');search.value='B-07';search.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));return states.reduce((a,s)=>(a[s]=(a[s]||0)+1,a),{})})()
